$comment: Which mark goes where. Vocabulary for every product: full = sign + wordmark, icon = sign alone, logotype = wordmark alone, card = the padded 5:3 version for og/social. Every product icon carries the Box Of Rules sign path from marks/box-of-rules/icon-*.svg, unchanged. Every SVG is cropped to its content (no margin, no background); every listed png is the same mark, transparent, 1024 px on the long edge. Cards are the one padded form. If a surface is not listed, ask James; never invent, redraw or recolour a mark.

typography.$comment: Which face each product uses, for headings, for body, and inside its wordmark. If it is not here, it is Syne + Barlow.

box-of-rules.heading: Syne
box-of-rules.wordmark: BOX OF RULES: the master logotype from the vault, outlined paths (not a live font)

web.$comment: Favicons, app icons, the web manifest and the <head> snippet, generated per product by tools/web-icons.py from the product's icon in marks/. A site copies web/<product>/ into its public/ root as is and pastes head.html into its layout. Never draw a favicon by hand.
